candidates.title: FBI reportedly probes database hack
candidates.body: An apparent intrusion targeted the system US police use for warrants and background checks, CNN reports.
candidates.headline: FBI reportedly probes apparent breach of crime database

candidates.title: Son’s $1tn SK Hynix idea is shelved
candidates.body: SoftBank told The Information it is no longer actively considering the deal.
candidates.headline: SoftBank’s Son explored a $1tn SK Hynix buyout: report

candidates.title: Anthropic's $1.6 trillion debut week
candidates.body: Only 6 US companies were worth more as Anthropic finished its first week of trading, CNBC reported.
candidates.headline: Anthropic ends its first trading week worth $1.6 trillion

candidates.title: FBI and USDA reportedly hacked
candidates.body: CNN says the FBI attack targeted a system used to share warrants and missing persons information.
candidates.headline: FBI and USDA reportedly hacked in fresh government breaches

candidates.title: Amazon nears deal to buy Decart
candidates.body: The Financial Times says Amazon is close to buying the Israeli video AI startup for $7.5 billion.
candidates.headline: Amazon nears $7.5B deal to buy video AI startup Decart

candidates.title: AI-aided Navier-Stokes proof claimed
candidates.body: The pair claim to remove the outside force used in OpenAI’s proof—but a numerical certificate is missing.
candidates.headline: Buckmaster and Alpöge claim Navier-Stokes blow-up without force

candidates.title: Microsoft confirms Entra data breach
candidates.body: Attackers exploited an API flaw; Microsoft fixed the vulnerability on November 19.
candidates.headline: Microsoft says Entra breach exposed admin email addresses

candidates.title: Wonder reportedly looks to sell Grubhub
candidates.body: Wonder paid $650 million for Grubhub early last year; now the Journal says it wants to sell.
candidates.headline: Wonder reportedly looks to sell Grubhub after Amazon switch

candidates.title: Neuralink participant plays GTA 6
candidates.body: Imagining a ring-finger tap lets a Neuralink trial participant trigger commands in GTA 6.
candidates.headline: Neuralink participant plays GTA 6 using only brain signals

candidates.title: SEC charges 8 over alleged crypto scam
candidates.body: The SEC says operators used fake SEC certificates to sell investors on bogus crypto platforms.
candidates.headline: SEC alleges fake crypto platforms stole more than $37M

candidates.title: Trump proposes overseas data center ban
candidates.body: Trump floated a “tremendous tax” as an alternative, without first discussing the proposal with advisers.
candidates.headline: Trump wants to ban US companies from building data centers abroad

candidates.title: SpaceX lenders resist orbital AI plans
candidates.body: Banks backing $43 billion in SpaceX debt would view chips sent into space as lost, insiders told the FT.
candidates.headline: SpaceX lenders seek to block AI chip launches into orbit, FT says

candidates.title: Trump addresses reported FBI hack
candidates.body: A former FBI official warns the concern is whether hackers could alter information officers rely on.
candidates.headline: Trump says reported FBI crime database hack is ‘not good’

candidates.title: Maple faces 'AI god' allegations
candidates.body: Former residents say Maple records even their breathing to train an AI modeled on its leader's mind.
candidates.headline: Former Maple members allege recordings aim to train an 'AI god'

candidates.title: Cognition reportedly in funding talks
candidates.body: Bloomberg says Devin's maker is weighing a raise of $2bn or more, two months after its last round.
candidates.headline: Report: Cognition in talks to raise at $75bn valuation

candidates.title: Gallego blasts crypto’s election tactics
candidates.body: Fairshake spent $55 million trying to stop Sherrod Brown from returning to the Senate. He won anyway.
candidates.headline: Gallego says crypto is ‘f*cked’ after Democrats’ sweep

candidates.title: Cursor weighs dropping Chinese AI models
candidates.body: A House report says Cursor cites “geopolitical risk”, but has no decision or timetable for a phaseout.
candidates.headline: Cursor may drop Chinese AI models, House committees say

candidates.title: Trump sees upside in reported FBI hack
candidates.body: "Maybe we’ll learn about the voter fraud," Trump said of the reported breach.
candidates.headline: Trump says reported FBI hack may reveal 'voter fraud'

candidates.title: Amazon: AI agents found a zero-day
candidates.body: Amazon says the agents reached file writing in roughly 11 minutes; root access came later.
candidates.headline: Amazon says AI agents found zero-day in imaging software

candidates.title: Cyberleek ties GTA 6 file to token goal
candidates.body: Cyberleek promises an early executable release if CYBERLEEK hits $15M; none of the files are verified.
candidates.headline: Cyberleek ties claimed GTA 6 leak to $15M token target
